_comment: Where the checkouts this plugin runs against live, per machine. A configured path is tried FIRST and the repo NAME second, because the folder a clone lands in varies per person and the repo it came from does not. That fallback is why a plugin works on a second person's machine. Never write a literal home path here and never write a phone number or email: a repo keeps them forever and discloses them to everyone who ever had access. Contact resolution goes through the operator's own relationships directory.
_workspace_is_a_guess: Each operator's Supersuit workspace is wherever they run the skills from; nothing in this plugin resolves a path from here. set-up-overnight-cos writes their settings to setup/overnight-cos.json in that workspace.
